Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo & eval kickoff

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on HealthSync's ingestion pipeline and the two evaluation priorities you mentioned (extraction accuracy for clinical notes + cost per processed encounter). Quick recap + suggested next steps so we can lock in a demo / evaluation kickoff: 

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary goal: reduce per-encounter inference cost by 40% while maintaining >= 92% extraction F1 on clinical note fields.
- Data modality: text notes from EHR (de-identified sample available).
- Success criteria: measured on your prompt set + 1k-sample holdout; speed/latency target 150ms p99 per request under evaluation load.
- Constraints: no PHI in transit; on-prem or VPC deployment required if evaluation expands beyond synthetic samples.

Proposed next steps
1) 60-minute technical deep dive + demo where we: show an end-to-end eval run, discuss model/quantization tradeoffs, and confirm data handling.
2) 2-week evaluation kickoff with trial charter (we've got a template attached) and an initial prompt set.
3) Define owners: you (Alicia) for product acceptance, Ben Wallace for ML criteria, and Priya for product workflows.

My availability for a 60-minute slot next week (PST):
- Tue 2027-04-20 09:00–10:00
- Tue 2027-04-20 13:00–14:00
- Wed 2027-04-21 11:00–12:00
(If none of these work, share a couple of options or book directly: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/sean_gallagher/30)

Attached: trial-charter-template.pdf (outline of kickoff scope) and redwood-kickoff-agenda.md (proposed agenda).

Prework request (short):
- If possible, please drop a small de-identified sample (100 notes) into the Drive link below before the call so we can run a quick baseline.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/HealthSync-Eval-Prep

Thanks — happy to tighten the agenda based on your priorities.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: trial-charter-template.pdf (PDF, 18KB), redwood-kickoff-agenda.md (plain text)

All three of us (me, Ben W., Priya) are aligned on scope. A couple of notes:
- The 150ms p99 target is aggressive but acceptable for the eval if we measure on a representative sample.
- For the initial kickoff we need a clear data handling step-by-step since security will approve only after a quick runbook review.

Availability (PST):
- Tue 2027-04-20 13:00–14:00 (best)
- Wed 2027-04-21 10:00–11:00 (possible)

We'll upload a 100-note de-identified sample to the Drive link by EOD Monday (2027-04-19). Also looping in Ben Wallace and Priya for technical acceptance criteria.

Quick Q: can you confirm whether the evaluation will require any inbound whitelist IPs for a hosted test, or should we plan on VPC from day one? Security will want that in the kickoff charter.

Best,

Thanks — appreciate the quick sync. The Tue 4/20 13:00–14:00 PST slot works for us, let’s lock that. I’ve tentatively booked it on the calendar and sent a calendar invite to the attendee list; please accept when convenient.

To answer your security question: for the initial 2-week evaluation we can run a hosted isolated test (no PHI) using IP allow-listing for the minimal set of egress endpoints. If the evaluation expands to real de-identified samples or higher volume, we’ll switch to a VPC/private deployment model. I’ve noted that in the attached charter under "Data & Security" (see section 3).

Agenda for the 60-minute deep dive (attached redwood-kickoff-agenda.md) — high level:
- 10m: Introductions & goals
- 20m: Live demo & eval run on a small sample (we’ll run baseline + 1 config)
- 15m: Model/quantization/cost tradeoffs & expected metrics
- 10m: Ops/ownership & timeline for the 2-week trial
- 5m: Q&A and next steps

Action items before the call:
- HealthSync: upload 100 de-identified notes to the Drive link by EOD Mon 4/19.
- Redwood: prepare a 1-config baseline on a similar clinical-note prompt set and share the baseline numbers in the demo.
- Both: Security contact info (name + email) for runbook exchange.

Attachments: trial-charter-template.pdf, redwood-kickoff-agenda.md

See you Tuesday,
